title: perf(console): the first load stops downloading the Studio designer strings and the metadata form strings
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X1BWM1V5bGUHJAmMNYdGNXk)_

Fixes #33582

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Seat `domain:ui#2` · os-project-manager · card thread `session_01FEkQ5ousB2MKFUbJFc3Hwp` · claim 6889348795 and its two amendments

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:控制台首次加载不再预先下载 Studio 设计器的英文字符串(64 KB gzip)和元数据表单字符串;它们改为在 Studio、Setup 或列表页真正用到时才下载。任何路由的首屏脚本从 2,165,707 字节(gzip)降到 2,058,464 字节,少了 107,243 字节(5.0%),首屏块从 107 个降到 103 个。
- 为什么改:#33582(#33293 的拆分卡)测得仪表盘等路由在取数前就要下载这两份字符串,而只有 Studio 和 Setup 画它们。把它们拽进首屏的是五个在加载时就注册或挂载的组件:Studio 画布的默认对象表格、Setup 数据源页、岗位列表的两个单元格、列表的「新建视图」对话框、预览条的「待发布更改」面板;现在都改为第一次画出时才加载。
- 风险与回滚:只改加载时机,不改任何界面画什么;英文仍是 Studio 字符串的同步兜底(#25922 不变)。数据源页首次打开时多一行「Loading…」;岗位列表两列在代码到达前留空一瞬;列表页挂载时会顺带下载「新建视图」对话框及其字符串(与 #33580 的视图配置面板同一形状)。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/studio-canvas-preview.tsx(默认画布改为按需加载并以同名导出注册,StudioDesignSurface 的身份比较不受影响)、ui/packages/app-shell/src/services/lazyPage.tsx(从 builtinComponents.tsx 移出的唯一 lazyPage 包装,加了可选 fallback)、ui/apps/console/vite.config.ts(新增 i18n-ns-studio 分块组)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter '@object-ui/console^...' build` 后在 `ui/apps/console` 跑 `CI=true pnpm exec vite build`,读 `dist/eager-closure.json`:`eagerGzipBytes` 应为 2,058,464 左右,`files` 里不再有 `i18n-ns-studio-en` 和 `metadata-form-i18n`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Measured first on `origin/main` `3c0033f9` with the instrument #33580 used (the console's own `vite.config.ts` run through Vite's `build()` plus one read-only plugin that dumps `getModuleInfo()` and every chunk's module list; that build writes the same `eager-closure.json` as a plain build): **107 eager chunks, 2,165,707 B gzip**. `i18n-ns-studio-en` (64,296 B) and `metadata-form-i18n` (11,363 B) are eager.

The edges, read from that graph (eager importers only):

| module | eager importer(s) on main | cut here |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/index.ts` | `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`; the module itself sits in the eager `i18n-runtime` group, with its static `en` edge | new `i18n-ns-studio` chunk group |
| `metadata-admin/i18n.ts` | `studio-design/studio-canvas-preview.tsx`, `metadata-admin/datasource/DatasourceResourcePage.tsx`, `metadata-admin/PositionGrantCells.tsx`, `metadata-admin/previews/useDatasetCatalog.ts` | all four, below |
| `metadata-admin/metadata-form-i18n.ts` | `preview/changeKeyLabels.ts` only, through `preview/DraftChangesPanel.tsx`, mounted closed by `preview/DraftPreviewBar.tsx` (in `ConsoleLayout`) | `DraftChangesPanel` lazy |

The cuts, each the #33580 shape:

- **`services/lazyPage.tsx` (new).** #33580's `lazyPage` moves here from `builtinComponents.tsx` unchanged, so the three registration sites below share the one wrapper. It gains an optional third argument, `fallback`, so a list cell draws nothing while its module loads instead of the page-sized loading line. `builtinComponents.tsx` imports it (and its fallback, still used by the two metadata-admin registrations).
- **`studio-design/studio-canvas-preview.tsx`** is imported by the package entry for its load-time `registerStudioCanvasPreview('object', …)` (it is in app-shell's `sideEffects`). The default grid and everything only it reads (the `@object-ui/react` renderer hooks, `useAuth`, the designer strings) move verbatim to **`studio-design/studio-object-records-canvas.tsx`**. The registry module keeps the registry, the contexts, `navEntryListTarget` and `listViewsOf`, and exports `StudioObjectRecordsCanvas` as `lazyPage('studio canvas', () => import('./studio-object-records-canvas.js'))`. The name is unchanged and is the value registered, so `StudioDesignSurface`'s `StudioCanvas === StudioObjectRecordsCanvas` check and the package entry's re-export need no edit.
- **`metadata-admin/datasource/register.ts`** registers `DatasourceResourcePage` through `lazyPage`, typed with the registry's `ListPage` props `{ type: string }`.
- **`services/builtinComponents.tsx`**: the position list's `PositionHolderCountCell` and `PositionGrantedSetsCell` are `lazyPage(…, null)`; the column `render` functions are unchanged.
- **`views/ObjectView.tsx`**: `CreateViewDialog` is `lazy()` with its mount inside `Suspense fallback={null}`, exactly as `ViewConfigPanel`. Nothing else in the file changes.
- **`preview/DraftPreviewBar.tsx`** (seat amendment 2): `DraftChangesPanel` is `lazy()` with its mount inside `Suspense fallback={null}`. The bar draws only in preview mode, so the sheet's chunk is requested only there.
- **`ui/apps/console/vite.config.ts`**: an `i18n-ns-studio` group for `namespaces/studio/index.ts` with `includeDependenciesRecursively: false`, beside the existing `i18n-ns-studio-en` / `-zh` groups and for the reason the marketplace loader's group gives. `en` stays a static import of the namespace module, so it stays the synchronous fallback (#25922); the module and its `en` catalogue leave the eager closure together.

Result, final head `58e603fe`, two builds of the same tree: **103 eager chunks, 2,058,464 B gzip** both times (the console:build dist served in the live check read the same), **−107,243 B (−5.0%)** against main.

| chunk | before, B gz | after |
|:--|--:|:--|
| `i18n-ns-studio-en` | 64,296 | **left the eager closure** |
| `metadata-form-i18n` | 11,363 | **left the eager closure** |
| `i18n` | 8,085 | left |
| `json-schema-to-fields` | 1,882 | left |
| `object-fields-io` | 1,578 | left |
| `useDatasetCatalog` | 1,059 | left |
| `objectViewTitleSwitcher` | 16,823 | 8,131 |
| `src` | 38,144 | 31,115 |
| `newViewSpec` | 4,236 | 309 |

Three small eager chunks appear: `usePendingDrafts` (1,490), `drillUrlFilters` (1,454) and `studio-canvas-preview` (919). They are modules that were already eager inside chunks that shrank, regrouped by rolldown; not new first-load bytes.

`pnpm check:eager-closure` on that build: exit 0, aggregate 2010.2 KB / 2431.6 KB ceiling, headroom 421.4 KB = **0.61x** the 695.0 KB regression. `evaluateHeadroomSensitivity`'s predicate (headroom ≥ 1x) does not fire, so the gate asks for no re-pin; `BASELINE` is untouched.

Changeset `.changeset/33582-console-eager-closure-studio-strings.md`: `@object-ui/console` patch (app-shell is private; the console's `dist` ships it). `Clause-②: no`: nothing a package exports changes shape; app-shell is private, its entry still exports `registerStudioCanvasPreview` with the same signature, and no `@object-ui/i18n` key is added or removed.

## Tests

- **New pin** in `studio-canvas-preview.test.tsx`, "the registered object default loads the grid on first draw (objectstack#33582)": the registered default is the wrapper, not the grid module's own component, and drawn through `getStudioCanvasPreview('object')`, as `StudioDesignSurface` draws it, it loads and draws the grid with the schema the module's component renders. The file's existing grid-behaviour tests (objectui#11774, objectui#11823) now render the module's own component, imported at module scope (`ui/AGENTS.md`, lazy-boundary rule).
- **Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `studio-canvas-preview.tsx`, the wrapper's loader `.then((m) => m.StudioObjectRecordsCanvas)` replaced by one that resolves a component drawing nothing): "drawn through the registry, it loads and draws the grid" **red** (1 failed, 1 passed, 15 skipped); restore: blob equal to HEAD `88577d58c086`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Census row moved**: `console/__tests__/openPathObjectReaders-12811.test.ts` classifies every source file that reads `useMetadata().objects`; the reader moved with the grid, so its row names `studio-object-records-canvas.tsx` (same `kind: 'off'`, same reason).
- **Affected suites**, from `ui/` under the lock: every `views/studio-design/*.test.ts(x)`, every test importing `ObjectView`, every `preview/*.test.tsx` and `CreateViewDialog*.test.tsx`, and every test naming the changed modules (`builtinComponents`, `PositionGrantCells`, the datasource registration, `register-builtins`): **500 files, 3,982 tests**. First run 498 files passed; the two red files were the canvas tests above (rendering the lazy name synchronously) and the census row. After the fix both files pass (20 / 20). The other 498 were not re-run after the test-only commit and the one-line type annotation.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (both `tsc` passes): exit 0 on the final head. The first console `build:dist` caught `TS2322` on the datasource registration (an optional `type` prop inferred); fixed by typing the wrapper with those props.
- eslint on the seven changed sources: 0 errors; warnings 70 on main to 60 here (the one new one is `react-refresh/only-export-components` on `lazyPage.tsx` exporting a function beside a component).
- The `ineffective-dynamic-import` ledger ("41 ineffective dynamic imports, all pinned") and `declared-lazy-views` ("11/12 … 1 eager, all pinned") print the same lines as on main, so none of the new `import()`s is defeated by a static edge.

## Acceptance notes

- **Card correction.** The card names four edges into `metadata-admin/i18n.ts` and says `metadata-form-i18n` rides the same edges. Measured on main, the four edges are exactly as named, but `metadata-form-i18n` is not held by them: its only eager importer is `preview/changeKeyLabels.ts`, reached through `preview/DraftChangesPanel.tsx`, which `preview/DraftPreviewBar.tsx` mounts closed. That edge also carried the `object-fields-io` straggler. The seat added `DraftPreviewBar.tsx` (the `DraftChangesPanel` import and mount only) to the claim before it was edited.
- **Where the strings now load.** Studio and Setup screens load them as before. A list route also requests them as the list mounts, because `CreateViewDialog` is mounted closed with the list and its chunk carries the dataset catalogue, as `ViewConfigPanel` does since #33580. They stay off the dashboard and every non-list route (live check below).
- `ObjectView` itself is still eager (AppContent's always-eager block): that is #33581's, not touched here. `AppContent` and `apps/console/src/register-plugins.ts` are not edited.
- No out-of-scope finding to file.

## Verification

Live, the built console (`turbo run build:dist --filter=@objectstack/console` at `58e603fe`) served by the showcase app (`objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin --no-watch`), a fresh browser context per route (cold cache, so every chunk the route needs is a request), Chromium via Playwright. Probe, screenshots and `routes.json`: `/mnt/project-files/pm-orders/ui/33582-probe/` in the project files.

| route | draws | moved chunks requested |
|:--|:--|:--|
| dashboard `showcase_ops_dashboard` | yes, no page errors | **none** of `i18n-ns-studio-en`, `i18n-ns-studio`, `metadata-form-i18n`, the canvas, the datasource page, the position cells, `CreateViewDialog`, `DraftChangesPanel` |
| task list, then view switcher → "Add new view" | the Create View dialog opens, English text ("Pick a view type, then give it a name…") | `CreateViewDialog`, `i18n-ns-studio(-en)`, `metadata-form-i18n` on list mount |
| Studio → Interfaces → Tasks (object leaf) | the runtime records grid in the canvas, English Studio chrome | the canvas module on clicking the leaf |
| Setup → Datasources | the datasources list (Default, External Analytics) | the datasource page, `i18n-ns-studio(-en)` |
| position list (`metadata/position`) | Holders and Permission sets columns filled per row | the position cells |

No route showed a raw `engine.*` string key or a console error.

<details><summary>Gates (local, head 58e603fe)</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 44 families. All run; 43 exit 0; `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: no `packages/qa/scenarios/dist`), NOT MEASURED, left to CI. `--ran` reconciliation: "44 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 43 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED". Per-family record: `/mnt/project-files/pm-orders/ui/33582-gates-ran.txt`. Outside the derived list: `pnpm --dir ui check:eager-closure` exit 0 (above).

</details>
